design.date_rule: all available month-end labels; no outcome-based date selection

random_partition_design.hypothesis: domain-structured assignment creates more independent books and less same-side concentration than an equally sized arbitrary partition of the same full packet

design.hypothesis: Separating access to research fields increases independent benchmark-relative active weights and reduces same-side active overlap under a long-only mandate.

mandate.benchmark: equal weight over the common 14-stock universe
mandate.analysis_representation: portfolio weights minus equal benchmark weights
mandate.weight_normalization: every complete non-negative vector with positive gross weight is normalized exactly to one; the raw sum and L1 adjustment are retained

quality_checks.active_share: reported separately so geometric changes are not confused with risk scale
quality_checks.permutation_null: preserves each long-only book's weights and permutes ticker identity

format_pilot_amendment.timing: after 157 valid and 9 invalid format-pilot responses; before outcome analysis
format_pilot_amendment.reason: Meta and Mistral repeatedly returned all 14 non-negative relative weights but made arithmetic sum errors. Scale carries no portfolio information under a fully invested mandate, so complete positive vectors are deterministically normalized.
format_pilot_amendment.applies_to: all models, dates, and information conditions

operating_performance.annualization: arithmetic monthly mean and standard deviation annualized by 12 and sqrt(12)
operating_performance.portfolio: date-level mean matched four-model portfolio for each design

turnover.status: descriptive; adjacent turnover transitions are not treated as independent inference units
turnover.definition: one-way turnover: half the absolute change in fully invested portfolio weights

scaling.analysis_status: post-hoc analysis of frozen books; no new LLM calls

design.matched_comparison: k distinct models sharing the rich packet versus one model receiving k distinct channels
design.interpretation: relative co-order concentration under the square-root impact convention; not a realized-cost estimate
design.adv_unit: billions of U.S. dollars; rescaled by the cross-sectional median within date
design.inference_unit: date; model combinations, channel subsets, and providers averaged within date

representative_heldout_case.selection_rule: held-out date nearest the median date-level N_eff gain; provider nearest that date's seven-provider mean specialist N_eff

heldout_regime_effects.analysis_status: post-hoc descriptive heterogeneity on the held-out dates
heldout_regime_effects.filing_activity_definition: high when the number of universe firms with a 10-Q or 10-K in the prior 30 days exceeds the held-out date median
